title: npm run fast is biome, tsc and related tests; guards run only in CI
body:
Evidence: .krn/runs/prune/gates.md (2026-11-21 gate audit): no refusal caught a defect present on main; operator 2026-11-21 'zamiast robić bramki realna inżynieria' (memory no-gates-just-code: CI Check is the only gate).
Outcome: fast runs no preflight guard (boundaries, receivers, byte budgets, literal bans) and prints one verdict; the guards still run in CI Check (~132 lines moved or deleted).
Proof: the named command prints the stated count; npm run fast PASS; CI Check green.
Files: see .krn/runs/prune/gates.md row
